item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We must treat this as a defining security challenge and act before that point arrives.

2. We believe the stakes are clear: superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will leave most countries unable to defend themselves. We need serious preparation now—not after the balance of power has shifted.

3. Most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years. We cannot afford to treat this as a distant or abstract concern. The time to prepare is now.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We are facing a defining security challenge. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. That is not a distant technical question; it is a direct threat to national security and the international order. We must prepare before this technology changes the balance of power, not after. That means confronting the risks openly, building the capacity to respond, and making this challenge a priority for leaders and institutions now. We cannot assume existing defenses will be enough. The choices we make in the coming years will shape whether countries can protect their people and preserve their independence in an era of superintelligent AI.
